I investigated the population of Maharashtra according to the 2011 census. The population was found to be 112,374,333. This figure is consistently reported across multiple reliable sources, including Wikipedia and Census2011.co.in. Maharashtra was the second most populous state in India at that time.
I was assigned to find the population of Bihar according to the 2011 census. I found that the population of Bihar was 104,099,452. This figure is based on the official Census of India 2011 data.
